shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.note: A shepherd, the flock, its pasture, its protection and its provision.

Shepherd.label: Luke 15:4
Shepherd.note: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them …”

Pasture.note: the ninety-nine left in the pasture

Protection.label: Luke 15:5
Protection.note: he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

Sheep.note: Jacob meets Rachel at the sheep well.

Pasture.note: Jacob seeks pasture in Canaan and Paddan-Aram:

Protection.note: Jacob protects his flocks from Laban’s exploitation:

Shepherd.note: “You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron”

Shepherd.note: “the days of Moses … the shepherds of His flock”

Pasture.note: “We are… the sheep of his pasture.”

Pasture.note: “I will feed them with good pasture… rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.”

Protection.label: Psalm 23:4
Protection.note: “Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.”

Protection.label: Isaiah 40:11
Protection.note: “He will gather the lambs in his arms.”

Provision.label: Ezekiel 34:15–16
Provision.note: “I myself will be the shepherd… I will feed them… seek the lost… bind up the injured.”

Pasture.note: “He will go in and out and find pasture.”

Protection.note: “No one will snatch them out of my hand.”

Protection.note: The hired hand flees; the true shepherd protects.

Provision.note: “He had compassion… they were like sheep without a shepherd.”

Shepherd.note: Elders told to shepherd the flock:

Protection.label: Revelation 7:16
Protection.note: No hunger, thirst, or scorching heat:

king.name: King
king.note: A king, his kingdom, the law, judgment, and peace.

King.label: 1 Kings 2:12
King.note: “Solomon sat on the throne… his kingdom firmly established.”

Kingdom.label: 1 Chronicles 29:23
Kingdom.note: “Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king.”

Law.label: 1 Kings 3:9–12
Law.note: Solomon asks for wisdom to judge.

King.label: 2 Kings 18:1–3

King.label: Revelation 19:16

Kingdom.label: Revelation 11:15
Kingdom.note: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord.”

Peace.label: Revelation 22:1–5
Peace.note: River of life; healing of nations.

King.label: Psalm 47:2–8

King.note: “The LORD reigns… your throne is established from of old.”

King.label: Isaiah 6:1–5
King.note: Isaiah sees the Lord “high and lifted up” on His throne.

priest.name: Priest
priest.note: A priest, sacrifice, cleansing, access, and presence.

Blessing.label: Acts 3:26
Blessing.note: God sent Jesus “to bless you by turning every one of you from your wickedness.”

Father.label: Galatians 4:4–7
Father.note: “God sent forth His Son… so we might receive adoption.”

Son.label: Galatians 4:4–7
Son.note: “God sent forth his Son… so we might receive adoption.”

Inheritance.label: Romans 8:17
Inheritance.note: “Heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ.”

Blessing.note: Blessing of Abraham comes to Gentiles through Christ.

Suffering.label: Isaiah 50:6

Suffering.label: Isaiah 53:3–5

Glory.label: Isaiah 52:13

Glory.note: “High and lifted up” (Isa 52:13); light to the nations (Isa 49:5–6).

Glory.label: Psalm 21:5

Glory.label: John 17:1–5

Glory.label: Luke 24:26
Glory.note: “Was it not necessary… to enter his glory?”

Glory.label: Hebrews 2:9–10
Glory.note: Crowned with glory and honor.

Suffering.label: 2 Corinthians 11:23–28
Suffering.note: Paul’s sufferings.

Suffering.label: Acts 5:40–41; 2 Corinthians 11:23–28
Suffering.note: Beatings, imprisonments, shipwrecks (Acts 5:40–41; 2 Cor 11:23–28).

Glory.label: 2 Corinthians 3:18
Glory.note: “Being transformed… from glory to glory.”

Suffering.label: 1 Peter 4:12–16
Suffering.note: Persecution, trials, discipline (1 Pet 4:12–16).

Glory.label: Romans 8:30
Glory.note: “Those he justified he also glorified.”

Glory.label: Colossians 3:4
Glory.note: “You also will appear with him in glory.”

Glory.label: Revelation 22:4–5
Glory.note: “They will see His face… they will reign forever” (Rev 22:4–5).

prophet.name: Prophet
prophet.note: A prophet, the word, confrontation, repentance, and restoration — a narrower form of the story pattern Sin, judgment and mercy.

Repentance.label: 2 Kings 22:11–13
Repentance.note: Josiah tears his clothes and seeks the word.

Prophet.label: 2 Kings 14:25
Prophet.note: “His servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet”

Prophet.label: Luke 3:2–6
Prophet.note: “The word of God came to John…”

Word.label: Matthew 3:1–2
Word.note: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.”

Confrontation.label: Matthew 14:3–4
Confrontation.note: “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

Repentance.label: Matthew 3:5–6
Repentance.note: Confessing sins, baptized in the Jordan.

Restoration.label: Luke 3:16–17
Restoration.note: Jesus brings Spirit and fire, separating wheat from chaff.

Prophet.label: 1 Samuel 3:19–21
Prophet.note: “The LORD… let none of his words fall to the ground.”

Word.label: 1 Samuel 3:21
Word.note: “The LORD revealed himself… by the word of the LORD.”

Confrontation.label: 1 Samuel 15:13–23
Confrontation.note: “You have rejected the word of the LORD.”

Restoration.label: 1 Samuel 7:10–13
Restoration.note: God delivers Israel from the Philistines.

Prophet.label: 1 Kings 17:1
Prophet.note: Elijah appears declaring the word of the LORD.

Word.label: 1 Kings 17:2–4
Word.note: “The word of the LORD came to him…”

Confrontation.label: 1 Kings 18:21
Confrontation.note: Confronts Israel: “How long will you waver?”

Repentance.label: 1 Kings 18:39
Repentance.note: People fall on their faces: “The LORD, He is God!”

Restoration.label: 1 Kings 18:39
Restoration.note: “The LORD, he is God!” — national turning.

Prophet.label: 2 Kings 2:15
Prophet.note: “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.”

Restoration.label: 2 Kings 5:14–19
Restoration.note: Naaman healed and confesses the true God.

Word.label: Isaiah 1:2–20
Word.note: Prophetic indictment begins with “Hear, O heavens…”

Repentance.label: Isaiah 37:1–4
Repentance.note: Hezekiah seeks the prophet in humility.

Repentance.label: Isaiah 55:6–7
Repentance.note: “Seek the LORD… let the wicked forsake his way.”

Restoration.label: Isaiah 55:6–13
Restoration.note: restoration through returning to the LORD.

Prophet.label: Jeremiah 1:4–10
Prophet.note: “I have put my words in your mouth.”

Word.label: Jeremiah 7:1–7
Word.note: Word to stand in the gate and proclaim.

Confrontation.label: Jeremiah 7:8–11
Confrontation.note: “Has this house… become a den of robbers?”

Restoration.label: Jeremiah 33:6–9
Restoration.note: “I will heal them… reveal abundance of peace.”

Word.label: Ezekiel 3:1–3
Word.note: Eats the scroll; word becomes part of him.

Prophet.label: Exodus 3:10–12
Prophet.note: God commissions Moses as His spokesman.

Prophet.label: Deuteronomy 18:15–18; Acts 3:22–23
Prophet.note: Jesus identified as the promised prophet.

Word.label: Exodus 4:12–16
Word.note: God gives Moses the words he must speak.

Repentance.label: Exodus 12:28
Repentance.note: Israel obeys the word of the LORD.

Repentance.label: Exodus 33:4–6
Repentance.note: Israel mourns after the golden calf.

Restoration.label: Numbers 14:20
Restoration.note: “I have pardoned according to your word.”

Repentance.label: Acts 3:19
Repentance.note: “Repent… that times of refreshing may come.”

Prophet.label: Revelation 22:9
Prophet.note: “a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets”

Prophet.label: Luke 7:16
Prophet.note: “A great prophet has arisen among us!”

Prophet.label: Acts 3:22–23
Prophet.note: Jesus is the Prophet like Moses.

Word.label: Mark 1:14–15
Word.note: “Jesus came… proclaiming the gospel of God.”

Restoration.label: Acts 3:19–21
Restoration.note: “Repent… that times of refreshing may come.”

warfare.name: Spiritual warfare
warfare.note: Submission to God, the powers, opposition, resistance, God's help, and standing. Submission comes first in the text (James 4:6–10; 1 Peter 5:5–10).

Submission.label: James 4:6–7
Submission.note: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble” (Prov 3:34) … “Submit yourselves, then, to God.”

Resistance.label: James 4:7
Resistance.note: “Resist the devil, and he will flee.”

Divine Aid.label: James 4:8–10
Divine Aid.note: “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you … Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you”

Submission.label: 1 Peter 5:5–6
Submission.note: the same Prov 3:34, “submit yourselves”, “humble yourselves … that He may exalt you”

Resistance.label: 1 Peter 5:9
Resistance.note: “Resist him, standing firm in your faith”

Divine Aid.label: 1 Peter 5:10
Divine Aid.note: “will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you”

Spiritual Powers.label: Ephesians 6:12
Spiritual Powers.note: “We wrestle not against flesh and blood…”

Spiritual Powers.label: Ephesians 6:11–12
Spiritual Powers.note: the devil’s schemes; rulers, authorities, powers of this world’s darkness

Resistance.label: Ephesians 6:10–18
Resistance.note: “Put on the whole armor of God.”

Resistance.label: Ephesians 6:13–17
Resistance.note: the full armor; “withstand” (ἀνθίστημι, the verb of Jas 4:7 and 1 Pet 5:9)

Stand / Victory.label: Ephesians 6:13–14
Stand / Victory.note: “having done everything, to stand. Stand firm then”

Submission.label: Matthew 4:10
Submission.note: “Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only”

Spiritual Powers.label: Matthew 4:1
Spiritual Powers.note: led by the Spirit into the wilderness “to be tempted by the devil”

Opposition.label: Matthew 4:3–9
Opposition.note: three temptations: bread, the pinnacle, the kingdoms

Resistance.label: Matthew 4:4
Resistance.note: “It is written … every word (ῥῆμα) that comes from the mouth of God” — Eph 6:17’s sword is “the word (ῥῆμα) of God”

Stand / Victory.label: Matthew 4:11
Stand / Victory.note: “Then the devil left Him” — Jas 4:7’s “he will flee from you”

Resistance.label: Revelation 12:11
Resistance.note: “They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb…”

Divine Aid.label: Hebrews 2:18
Divine Aid.note: Jesus helps those who are tempted.

Stand / Victory.label: Romans 16:20
Stand / Victory.note: “The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet.”
